newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales reductions of 23,800 MT were primarily the result of increases for Saudi Arabia (64,500 MT), Japan (63,000 MT), and Algeria (35,500 MT) being more than offset by reductions for unknown destinations (176,600 MT) and South Korea (52,500 MT).
Sales of 160,100 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Japan (146,500 MT).

Exports of 651,300 MT were 6 percent below the week earlier and 3 percent below the 4-week average. The principal destinations were Japan (218,800 MT), Taiwan (103,900 MT), Egypt (86,000 MT), Saudi Arabia (64,500 MT), and Mexico (64,000 MT).
